cross_check_XCHK2.detail: numpy is absent, so the optional Dickman-rho re-derivation of L_paper/L_mem was not run. Per specification.infrastructure_failure_disposition this is INFRASTRUCTURE SIGNAL, changes no reported number, and is not a finding about the cost model.

determinism_note: No randomness is used anywhere; a re-run is byte-identical apart from timing fields.

T1.known_limitation_carried: Every T1 row uses primes_used in {[2,3], [2,3,5]}; RT-20260805-92751c OBJ-1 states the operating ell at NIST-I is far larger and that per-entry cost rises with it.

T2.convention_note: L_prev equals P/2 at all five rows to the stated precision (the paper's own convention log2 k_DG = 0). This is a TRANSCRIPTION, not an independently verified Delfs-Galbraith constant (HEUR-XO-2).

measured_inputs: T1 avg_mults_per_entry at log2 p in [9, 40] (prior measurement, re-read and hash-bound here; NOT re-measured by this run)
modeled_outputs: every T_A, T_B, Delta, p*, band, gap and displacement in this file
optimistic_assumptions_carried: HEUR-XO-1: the affine per-entry law fitted at log2 p in [9, 40] with ell in {2,3,5} is used at log2 p in [256, 768]; extrapolation_ratio in [6.4, 19.2].
HEUR-XO-2: log2 k_DG = 0 is a transcription of the paper's own previous-methods column, not an independently verified constant.
HEUR-XO-3: exactly one memory-charging convention is physically correct; the corpus commits both and reconciles neither.
Wesolowski Heuristic 1 is assumed and is UNVALIDATED in this corpus.
c = 0.0 and A = -1.736966 (pure RAM) are attacker-favourable corners, never neutral defaults.
transcribed_inputs: T2 L_paper / L_mem / L_prev (paper Section 4.1 transcription)
T3 declared scalars S_struct, A, c, log2_k_DG, storage figures

MONO-1.method: finite difference on the 13 adjacent segments of the declared 14-value w grid, at every committed P row and every theta; segments that straddle the clamp are reported separately and compared against the clamp-implied slope
MONO-1.statement: d(Delta)/d(log2 w) = +0.5 exactly under MC_P13 while log2 w < L_mem(P) and 0 exactly at or above it; -0.5 exactly under MC_VOW wherever the assessed method is feasible.

MONO-2.method: bisection on a backward finite-difference slope of the assembled Delta (h = 1e-11), 200 iterations; this measures the kink of the assembled function rather than reading the min() clamp
MONO-2.statement: The kink in Delta versus log2 w under MC_P13 sits at exactly L_mem(P) for the five committed rows.

MONO-3.statement: p*(w) is non-increasing in w under MC_P13 and non-decreasing under MC_VOW, wherever at least two numeric loci exist within one theta; otherwise NOT_EVALUABLE(n = count), NEVER pass.

MONO-4.statement: MC_P13 and MC_VOW differ by at least 0.5 bits in Delta at some evaluated cell with log2 w >= 10.

MONO-5.kind: DATA CHECK on the 5 committed T2 rows
MONO-5.why_it_matters: L_paper(P) - P/3 is the only in-corpus handle on the superpolynomial o(1) term.

null_object.identical_code_path: both null arms are solved by solve_cell(), the same function used for L1..L4, with only E(.) swapped; no separate solver exists
null_object.preregistered_prediction: min D_null0 >= 11.9 bits and max D_null0 <= 14.2 bits, increasing monotonically in P; D_null1 at P = 256 in [1.5, 4.0] bits; and D_null1 < D_null0 at EVERY evaluated P.

surface_identity_check.note: D_null on the margin surface must equal |E_law(P) - E_null(P)| exactly, since the two arms differ only in E; verified on a 3-P x full-theta subgrid of actual Delta evaluations

comparison.interpretation_withheld: this run reports the two fractions; the F2 judgement is the reviewer's

band_width_comparison_at_P256_w30.note: Delta is invariant in A (A cancels), so the A-free count is the number of distinct margin values; cells where MC_VOW is memory-infeasible at this w are excluded and counted separately

convention_sign_comparison_at_P_256.note: comparison is at the window's low endpoint P = 256; cells where MC_VOW is memory-infeasible are not comparable and are excluded from the counts

p_star_summary.decisiveness_note: a convention producing 100% of a single categorical label is reported as decisive, not averaged into a band

A_cancellation_check.statement: A appears on both sides of Delta and cancels; it is retained in T_A and T_B (where it matters for the absolute-cost gate) and is not silently dropped.

RG-1.statement: For each of L1..L4: T_A(256) with S=0, A=0, c=0 lies in [118.25, 118.75].

RG-4.UNIT_MIXING_DISCLOSURE: The two endpoints of the committed headline bracket [118.5, 123.0] are in DIFFERENT UNITS. The low endpoint 2^{118.5} is stated by red_team_concrete_cost.yaml verdict.security_estimate_range.F_p2_operations as an F_{p^2}-operation count; the high endpoint 2^{123} is the upper end of AES_equivalent_hardware. This run reproduces each endpoint in its own unit and reports the mixing rather than silently converting. This is a disclosure ABOUT THE INPUT RECORD, not a defect of this run.
RG-4.statement: EV-SSI-59f7a2's headline bracket [118.5, 123.0] is reproduced with both endpoints within 0.25 bits, and the UNIT of each endpoint is recorded.
RG-4.unit_of_high_endpoint: log2 AES-equivalents, hardware model alpha = 3 (S = 3.0, A = 1.584963)

named_subgrid_reproducing_6_to_11.rule: the set of (law, S, A) cells at c = 0, P = 256 whose gap below 2^128 lies inside [6, 11] bits

RG-5.statement: Over the scenario grid at P = 256 (4 laws x 2 S x 4 A, c = 0), min gap <= 6.5 and max gap >= 10.5, covering the committed interval [6, 11] bits.

reproduction_gate.on_failure_rule: RUN INVALID; nothing else may be emitted (proposal falsifier F1).
reproduction_gate.units_note: T_A here is in log2 F_{p^2}-operations when A = 0, and in log2 AES-equivalents when A != 0.

SCOPE-A_advantage_over_matched_baseline.axis: advantage over the matched Delfs-Galbraith / previous-methods baseline
SCOPE-A_advantage_over_matched_baseline.reference_scenario: law L1, S = 0, A = 0, c = 0, log2 k_DG = 0

SCOPE-B_gap_below_the_levels_own_target.axis: assessed cost against the level's own classical target
SCOPE-B_gap_below_the_levels_own_target.note: On this axis NIST-III/V are not safer than NIST-I in the unbounded-memory model; each figure requires 2^{L_mem} table entries and is conditional on Heuristic 1.
SCOPE-B_gap_below_the_levels_own_target.preregistered_prediction: gap below target INCREASES with level

SCOPE-C_memory_feasibility.axis: required table memory against the committed global-storage figure
SCOPE-C_memory_feasibility.preregistered_prediction: infeasible at all three levels, with infeasibility INCREASING with level

scope.forbidden_sentence_note: The unqualified sentence about NIST-III/V retaining margin is not used anywhere in this package; every use names its axis.
scope.mandatory_qualifier: Every cost number below is conditional on Wesolowski's Heuristic 1 (unvalidated in this corpus) and on HEUR-XO-1..3, and is stated together with the memory requirement it needs: 2^{L_mem} table entries at the same P. Nothing here is an executed attack and nothing here is a security claim.

L5_extrapolation_sensitivity.status: NOT a member of the main scenario band and NOT part of the reproduction gate; reported separately

SANITY-1.audit_question: does MC_P13 imply that REDUCING memory below L_mem(P) makes the assessed method CHEAPER?
SANITY-1.convention_reading: the committed MC_P13 formula gives the vOW memory discount to the ASSESSED METHOD; the discount shrinks with memory and is clamped at L_mem(P)
SANITY-1.measured_answer: NO under the committed formula: dT_A/d(log2 w) is negative below the clamp, so cost FALLS as memory RISES and RISES as memory falls.
SANITY-1.recorded_discrepancy: H-SSI-7fe2bf HEUR-XO-3 supporting_results states that MC-P13 'as written it makes the assessed method CHEAPER as memory shrinks below M'. The formula as committed in specification.yaml (T_A = ... - 0.5*min(log2 w, L_mem)) and in cost_model.py line 236 (T_w_vOW = T_full / sqrt(min(w, M))) yields the OPPOSITE direction: cost rises as memory shrinks. This run reports the measured sign and does not resolve the discrepancy; it is recorded for the Coordinator and reviewers.

adversarial_corner.definition: per-entry law giving the smallest E at P = 256, S = 0, A = -1.736966 (pure RAM, the attacker-favourable corner that OBJ-6 flags as most attacker-favorable), c = 0.0, MC_P13, log2 k_DG = 0

log2_k_DG_sensitivity.ratio_form_note: Delta(log2_k_DG) = Delta(0) + log2_k_DG; the ratio form is primary and k-free, the absolute locus is emitted at log2 k_DG = 0 only, with independently_transcribed: false (HEUR-XO-2)

smallest_abs_delta_in_grid.knife_edge_rule: a minimum below 1 bit at a memory-feasible cell means the comparison is knife-edge there; the locus in that neighbourhood is reported as the unit-grid bracket containing the root, not as a bare point

undefined_segments_summary.L3_design_time_check: a3*P + b3 > 0 on [256, 768]; the design-time note says this guard does not fire
undefined_segments_summary.universal_guard: every cell carries fit_window_extrapolation: true with extrapolation_ratio = P/40 in [6.4, 19.2]
